text:
Maya Lopez: Noting a cluster of DB-connect failures (3 incidents in 5 weeks). Before we finalize postmortem fixes, we need to agree on customer comms and RCA-sharing rules.

Tom Reynolds: Agreed. Main asks: clearer statuspage wording + a predictable way for customers to request RCAs.

Elena Park: From Security/Legal: public wording should be high-level. Offer full RCAs on request; default to redacted. Any unredacted sharing requires explicit customer consent and Legal approval.

Maya Lopez: Suggested decisions:
1) Statuspage blurb: one sentence, specific but calm (ops will draft).
2) 72-hour customer summary: short plain-language email auto-sent to impacted customers.
3) Full RCA: available via Support on request; redacted by default; unredacted by exception (Legal).

Tom Reynolds: I'll add a consent checkbox to the Support form: "I request the full technical report and consent to share logs." Also propose tagging related postmortems with `recurring-db-conn` and auto-creating a mitigation ticket if >=2 matches in 21 days.

Elena Park: I'll publish a redaction checklist and escalation matrix by Thu.

incident-bot: Created tasks: INC-DB-4001 (72h template) -> Maya Lopez due 2201150000; INC-DB-4002 (support consent checkbox) -> Tom Reynolds due 2201180000; INC-DB-4003 (redaction checklist) -> Elena Park due 2201160000.

Support Bot: Draft Support form update available: https://support.redwood/drafts/rca-consent

Maya Lopez: Let's run a short 20-minute sync tomorrow to finalize the blurb and the 72h template. I'll send invite for 10:30 PT. Please keep tracker updates and tag me if anything slips. :white_check_mark:
